summary: Liberty Latin America Ltd. filed an 8-K announcing the declaration of a special dividend of Series A Preference Shares. For every ten common shares, holders receive one share of newly issued 9.0% Fixed Rate Cumulative Perpetual Redeemable Series A Preference Shares, par value $0.01. The dividend is payable quarterly starting September 15, 2026, at 9.0% per annum of the liquidation price. Unpaid dividends accumulate and increase the liquidation price after a 30-day cure period. The board authorized the dividend via an authorized committee. This capital return distributes preferred equity, not cash, enhancing shareholder yield. Watch for potential redemption terms and liquidity impact on common shares; risk-arb angle is limited as it's a dividend, not an M&A event.
